lead: Two `catch` clauses in one file may reuse a variable name only at the same class.
body: `catch (IOError $error)` and a later `catch (RuntimeError $error)` is `E0406` "already declared", because a catch variable is function-scoped like the `foreach` binding above; `tests/hostile/core/Response/sendFile/01-paths-outside-the-allowed-folder.nvs` is an attack that hit it. Give each class its own name (`$failed`, `$denied`, `$error`) and keep it for every `try` in the file.
